gate: Financial Command Center & Reports V1 Qualification
classification: FINLIFE FINANCIAL COMMAND CENTER & REPORTS V1 — FUNCTIONALLY QUALIFIED, REGRESSION-VERIFIED, AND FROZEN AS A RELEASE-CANDIDATE BASELINE — READ-ONLY, NON-FABRICATING, AND CROSS-MODULE RECONCILED.

definitions.AVAILABLE: Authoritative data loaded and reconciled with zero errors
definitions.STALE: Cached data available; background sync pending or network offline
definitions.PARTIAL: Some data items missing or in-flight; calculation withheld or marked partial
definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Domain data temporarily unreachable, missing required keys, or failed to resolve
definitions.CORRUPT: Unparseable records, tampered checksums, or schema violation detected
definitions.ERROR: System exception, storage locked, or unhandled query failure
definitions.EMPTY: Zero records exist for this domain (valid clean Day-0 state)
definitions.LOADING: Asynchronous query/computation in flight before status determination (transient presentation state)

underlyingDomains: Cashbooks (5 Logical Books partitioned across unified storage collections)

environmentScope.boundary: Automated emulator qualification verified. Physical Android devices, OEM-specific behavior, production security, store packaging, physical hardware backup/restore, and Doze/OEM process resuscitation remain pending in subsequent gates.
